en.faqTitle: A little clarity, before you start.

faqs.question: Do I install it on my phone or my computer?
faqs.answer: Both. Your computer stores the originals; the phone app transfers and browses your photos. Start with the desktop instructions in the installation section on this page, then get the phone app.

faqs.question: Do I have to do something every day?
faqs.answer: Your computer needs to be on and reachable to receive backups. Phone operating systems limit background activity. For your first or a large backup, keep the app open and check completion; installing the app alone does not mean your photos are backed up.

faqs.question: Can I delete photos from my phone afterward?
faqs.answer: Check backup status, open the files on your computer, and keep another independent copy of important photos before removing phone originals. Start with a small batch while you learn the process.

faqs.question: What if my computer breaks?
faqs.answer: Local storage is not a guarantee against loss. Drives can fail and files can be accidentally deleted. Regularly copy important photos to a separate drive and check that those files open correctly.

faqs.question: Does my computer need to be on to view photos?
faqs.answer: To access originals stored on your computer, it must be on and reachable. Offline browsing on your phone depends on what the app has cached; do not assume every original is available offline.

en.closingEyebrow: Make room for the next chapter
en.closingTitle: Start with a few favorite photos.
en.closingText: Try one complete backup, check your photos, and get comfortable with the process.

zh.faqTitle: 开始之前，聊清楚几件事。

faqs.question: 是装在手机上，还是电脑上？
faqs.answer: 两个都需要。电脑端负责保存原文件，手机应用负责传输和浏览照片。在本页的“安装与下载”区域，先安装电脑端，再获取手机应用。

faqs.question: 需要我每天手动操作吗？
faqs.answer: 备份需要电脑开机，且手机能够连接到它。手机系统会限制应用在后台的运行；第一次备份或照片较多时，建议打开应用进行备份，并查看是否完成，不把“已经安装”当作“已经备份”。

faqs.question: 备份以后，手机里的照片就能删了吗？
faqs.answer: 先检查备份状态，打开电脑中的照片和视频确认完整可用，并为重要内容保留另一份独立副本，再考虑清理手机原文件。首次使用时，建议先用少量照片熟悉流程。

faqs.question: 如果电脑坏了，照片会不会也丢？
faqs.answer: 存在电脑上不等于永远不会丢。硬盘故障或误删除仍可能导致照片丢失。建议定期把重要照片再复制到另一块独立硬盘，并检查这份副本能正常打开。

faqs.question: 以后找照片，需要电脑一直开着吗？
faqs.answer: 读取保存在电脑里的原文件时，电脑需要开机且网络可达。手机能离线查看哪些内容，取决于应用已缓存的内容；不要假设所有原图都可以离线打开。
